title: E · Review from the smallest item upwards
summary: Independent questions within a level can share one Jev request. Parent levels consume completed child results.
body:
Independent questions within a level can share one Jev request. Parent levels consume completed child results.

One Jev API serves these questions; no separately deployed evaluator per box.

A parent PASS cannot erase a failed child. An unexplained subjective failure becomes unresolved, not a speculative full rewrite.
